title: Gimbal control
description: A tactile grip moves a pan-and-tilt viewfinder and returns to neutral on release.
useCase: Move a virtual camera target with momentary two-axis input and a clear neutral position.
interaction: Drag or hold arrow keys; release to return to center.
reducedMotion: No idle animation; reduced motion and keyboard input update immediately.
limitations: Position demonstration only; does not control a real camera.
look: Silver hardware panel with screws, a dark grid viewfinder with crosshair, monospace readouts, and an orange ribbed grip in a stepped black well.
motion: Dragging pushes the grip within a circular limit, tilting it in 3D as nested rings and crosshair follow; release eases to centre with 450 ms overshoot; arrow keys move instantly.
adapt: Pointer mapping and the unit-circle clamp are `move` and `limit`; layer travel is in inline transforms (`point.x * 27`, tilt `13` deg, fold scales `[0.13, 0.3, 0.5]`), and the return is `450ms cubic-bezier(.2,1.25,.3,1)`. Wire `point` to your target and replace the viewfinder.
